nodes.label: Spec-First AI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Enforces Spec -> Plan -> Task -> Implementation -> Validation -> Documentation order, with a narrow exception for small self-contained UI corrections, to prevent implementing code from vague requests and to keep any scope expansion explicitly documented.

nodes.label: 5% Duplication Threshold Rule
nodes.rationale: Caps duplicated lines in src/ at 5% (jscpd, --min-tokens 50, --threshold 5) so small incidental repeats are ignored while larger clones force extraction into shared components/hooks under src/components/common/, keeping the check usable as a CI/local gate.

nodes.label: Plan 032 - Currency Input Mask
nodes.rationale: Post-implementation adjustment (2026-06-10): mask reimplemented with react-native-currency-input (JS-only) for keystroke-level fluidity, at the user's explicit request; the original src/lib/currencyMask.ts helper and its tests were removed as superseded dead code.

nodes.label: Plan 033 - Salary Distribution Panel
nodes.rationale: Panel is composition/display only; all math reuses existing helpers. Tail grouping and segment labels are derived in the component from the single builder object so the builder stays pure and display-agnostic; denominator switches to totalExpenses in the over-budget case so the bar always fills to 100%.

nodes.label: Plan 034 - Due Date Reminders
nodes.rationale: expo-notifications is the justified single new dependency because reminders are fully local (no backend/account/paid service). Reminder settings persist separately from finance data (mirroring the app-lock precedent) and are excluded from .c12f backup since they are device-local, not financial data.

nodes.label: Plan 035 - Spending Trends and Averages
nodes.rationale: Turns the existing monthHistory into insight with no new storage or dependencies; math lives in pure helpers. Uses a neutral informational color for trend text instead of reusing resolveCommitmentColor, so trends are not confused with the commitment semaphore.

nodes.label: Plan 036 - Commitment Goal
nodes.rationale: Adds a personal commitment goal marker/tag without changing the existing commitment color semaphore or thresholds (resolveCommitmentColor, commitmentWarningThreshold, commitmentDangerThreshold are explicitly untouched) to avoid conflating two distinct signals.

nodes.label: Plan 037 - Android Notification Icon
nodes.rationale: Uses the existing Cycle12 '12' mark rather than a new visual direction, tinted with the existing orange brand accent; native configuration/asset change only, so no new business-logic tests are required.
